label: academic-research-skills
description: ARS — human-in-the-loop research/writing/peer-review pipeline for academic papers, https://github.com/Imbad0202/academic-research-skills. Codex uses the separate ars-codex sibling distribution

installs.shell: claude plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills && claude plugin install academic-research-skills@academic-research-skills --scope user
codex plugin marketplace add Imbad0202/academic-research-skills-codex --ref main && codex plugin add ars-codex@ars-codex

label: agent-skills
description: Addy Osmani's 24 production-grade SDLC skills, spec through ship — https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills

installs.shell: claude plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills && claude plugin install agent-skills@addy-agent-skills --scope user

label: ast-grep

installs.shell: claude plugin marketplace add JuliusBrussee/caveman && claude plugin install caveman@caveman --scope user
claude plugin marketplace add ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp && claude plugin install chrome-devtools-mcp@chrome-devtools-plugins --scope user

installs.shell: claude plugin marketplace add openai/codex-plugin-cc && claude plugin install codex@openai-codex --scope user

label: compound-engineering
description: Every.to's compound engineering skill pack (brainstorm/plan/work/simplify/review/compound loop) — https://every.to/guides/compound-engineering, https://github.com/everyinc/compound-engineering-plugin

installs.shell: claude plugin marketplace add EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin && claude plugin install compound-engineering@compound-engineering-plugin --scope user
codex plugin marketplace add EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin && codex plugin add compound-engineering@compound-engineering-plugin

label: context7
description: docs MCP server — Claude gets the official marketplace plugin, Codex gets a direct mcp add, ctx7 setup covers Cursor/opencode/VS Code/30+ other clients

label: ecc
description: Enterprise Claude Configuration — agents, skills, hooks, rules, MCP config across Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex. Plugin install doesn't distribute rules/ — copy the language dirs you need to ~/.claude/rules/ecc/ afterward. See https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC

installs.shell: claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC && claude plugin install ecc

label: github-mcp-server
description: official GitHub MCP server (github/github-mcp-server), remote-hosted at api.githubcopilot.com — first use needs OAuth or a GitHub PAT. This project's .ai/mcp-servers.json already registers a 'github' entry via the older community @modelcontextprotocol/server-github package for this repo; the two aren't the same server, worth reconciling if both end up active

installs.shell: codex mcp add github --url https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ --bearer-token-env-var GITHUB_PAT_TOKEN

label: hyperframes
description: HeyGen HyperFrames — write HTML, render video (compositions, GSAP/runtime animations, captions, voiceovers, website-to-video) — https://hyperframes.heygen.com, https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes

label: magnific
description: official Magnific MCP — image/video generation and upscaling; OAuth sign-in, no API key; remote streamable-HTTP server at mcp.magnific.com — https://www.magnific.com/mcp

installs.shell: claude plugin marketplace add kepano/obsidian-skills && claude plugin install obsidian@obsidian-skills --scope user

label: playwright

label: security-guidance
description: pattern-based warnings on edits + LLM diff review on Stop + agentic commit reviewer (injection, XSS, SSRF, hardcoded secrets, 25+ vuln classes) — hooks-based, Claude Code only, no equivalent for other agents yet

label: typescript-lsp
description: typescript-language-server code intelligence — Claude Code LSP plugin only; VS Code-based tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot) already bundle a TS language service, no separate install needed there

installs.shell: npm install -g typescript-language-server typescript && claude plugin install typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official --scope user
